name: Darkweave Spinner
descr: A boar-sized arachnid woven from primordial shadow-silk.

features.name: Wrap in Shadow-Silk
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target is _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained_ until they succeed on a Strength Roll (10).

features.name: Shadow Fang
features.text: When the Spinner makes a successful attack against a target within Melee range, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target _Shaky_ until they succeed on an Instinct Roll (10). While _Shaky_, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls.
